instructions: Review against AGENTS.md (the hard rules) and CONTRIBUTING.md, and the domain skills under .pi/skills. Treat as blocking: credentials in code, logs or prompts; a bypass of the session, Origin or SSH host-identity checks; per-host isolation weakened; browser-reachable arbitrary shell; capture beyond enabled sources; Foundry human decisions made by automation; a retired feature (Work, built-in terminal, usage overview) coming back; an edited SQLite migration instead of a new one. Prefer the least code that is obviously correct; flag duplicated logic where an existing helper fits. Do not comment on formatting (gofmt and the TypeScript compiler enforce it). Vendored code under third_party is reviewed only where the diff touches the integration patches.
